records.title: RWKV-TS+: Adaptive Long-Range Prompt for Multiple Time Series Tasks
records.reason: Abstract is time-series forecasting/classification/anomaly/imputation architecture; not LLM inference/serving.

records.title: FedKD: A Fine-Grained Parameter-Efficient Federated Co-Tuning Framework With Knowledge Decoupling for Large and Small Foundation Models
records.reason: Abstract proposes federated foundation-model co-tuning, adapter/distillation and aggregation for training; training-only efficiency is outside scope.

records.title: Hi-MAC: An Intelligent MAC for Heterogeneous Wireless Network
records.reason: Abstract studies wireless MAC spectrum-sharing decisions; its ML inference is a small networking component, not LLM inference/serving.

records.title: Optimizing Task Offloading in NOMA-Enhanced MEC Systems via Large Model-Assisted Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: Large-model-assisted RL optimizes wireless MEC task-offloading energy/delay; the target efficiency is network task allocation, not LLM serving.

records.title: DRL-Enabled Polymorphic Acceleration Framework for Flexible and Energy-Efficient Hybrid-Float Deep Learning Inference in Mobile Computing
records.reason: Hybrid-float FPGA inference is evaluated on CNNs and BERT; it is general DNN/mobile acceleration without an LLM serving or generation study.
